Name: Trinkets To Treasures (Simplified)
Author: Bennoloth
Description:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14308]Trinkets to Treasures﻿[/url]﻿ is a mod by destroyer11687 that enables you to craft and enchant a wide variety of items in the game.
I have boiled that mod down to just the Display Cases which are used to increase sell price of artifacts, which you can see in the screenshot section.

Unlocking the Display Station to craft Display Cases requires 9 Hearts with both the Dwarf and Krobus.
Along the way, you will experience new Heart Events where you get to know the Dwarf (and a bit of Krobus) better.

The final cutscene is taken and modified from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9342]More Krobus[/url]﻿ mod, removing some of the complicated parts of that cutscene as well.

This mod is different from the standalone Trinkets to Treasures (Artifacts) in that there are far fewer objects added to the game, and the requirements to get the objects are simpler, without any quests involved, just relationship with the Dwarf (and Krobus).

[b]Here are explanations of the Heart Events:[/b]

[spoiler][b]Dwarf 3 Hearts:[/b] You catch the Dwarf sneaking around town (as he says he does in some of his vanilla dialogues)
- Triggered by entering your house from 11:00 PM - 2:00 AM after receiving the Dwarven Translation Guide museum reward

[b]Dwarf 6 Hearts :[/b] You catch the Dwarf breaking into a building in town, and he starts to soften up a bit
- Triggered by entering Pelican Town from 11:00 PM - 2:00 AM after having seen the Dwarf's 3 Heart event and visiting him in his cave after, and Abigail's 6 Heart event

[b]Dwarf 9 Hearts and Krobus 9 Hearts:[/b] Dwarf and Krobus finally bond, with your help
- Triggered by entering the Mines from 11:00 PM - 2:00 AM after having seen the Dwarf's 50 relationship and 6 Heart events, cannot trigger on a Friday[/spoiler]

[b]Here are the prices of Display Cases when unlocked:
[/b]
[spoiler]All Display Cases require 1 Hardwood to craft, and increase the base artifact in value by 10x except
 
[b]Golden Mask/Golden Relic[/b] - 50x
[b]Strange Dolls/Dinosaur Eggs[/b] - 5x
[b]Bone items[/b] - +100g (no big multiplier, so that selling them doesn't overshadow the Bone Mill)[/spoiler]

[b]Two "Secret" Display Case Combinations:[/b]

[spoiler][b]Dwarven Translation Guide Display[/b] [b]Case[/b] - 1 of each Dwarf Scroll

[b]Prismatic Jelly Display[/b] - 6 Green, 2 Red, and 1 Blue Slime Egg[/spoiler]

The "Secret" Display Cases are only accessible via the Optional File in Downloads, and require [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework Mod[/url], while the main mod does not.

I have been in contact with destroyer11687 and yuhvy and they have thankfully blessed me with permission to post this mod.

Please see also my mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16209]Price Buffs[/url] which the sell values for artifacts/Display Cases in this mod work very well with.
The original Trinkets to Treasures was balanced with Better Balance as a balance mod in mind, which overall reduces sell prices/slows the game down, while Price Buffs is a mod which uses a philosophy of bringing weak choices up to strong ones instead.

Check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26148]Dwarf Sells Cheaper Bombs[/url] for another unintrusive way to make the Dwarf more worth talking to.

[b]1.6 Spoiler Commentary:[/b]

[spoiler]The new book [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Treasure_Appraisal_Guide]Treasure Appraisal Guide[/url] increases the price of artifacts 3x, however it does NOT affect Display Case prices. So, the balance of this mod remains untouched. It is a useful book for cheaper artifacts that you did not want to go through the effort of processing.[/spoiler]﻿

+

If you enjoy my mods, consider supporting me on [url=https://ko-fi.com/bennoloth]Ko-Fi[/url]﻿

Downloads.Description:
Updated for 1.6.9. If you have made any display cases prior to downloading this new version, you should trash them, and spawn in the same value worth of display cases to sell with CJB item spawner.
1.6.9 prevented the display cases from being sold.
